source.repro: npx esbuild plugins/maf/benches/mafOnMarks.bench.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=/tmp/mafOnMarks.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node --max-old-space-size=14000 /tmp/mafOnMarks.mjs --rounds=9 --identity --json
source.notes: On ada (24 cores, load ~5-7). One fetched region of the synthetic MAF-tabix fixture per shape, identity per species over 64 bp bins. MAF display is the worker's pack, placeMafRegionData and buildIdentityRuns; control is the same declared again. Lanes is the bench-only column cells and binnedMeanColumns, which encodes nothing. Fused is the declared identity - cells, bin over fields ['start', 'end'], aggregate mean of match weighted by overlap - over mafFeatureTableOf (the pack inside the timing), split on species and encoded as a bar's y; unfused is the same with the bin in the facet's steps and the aggregate in the layer's, so the piece table is built. Interleaved round-robin with the order rotated, MIN across rounds. Error is the distance from bases matched over bases compared per species and bin, counted off the text: the declared identity's, checked equal fused and unfused and over the features before timing, and the start-bin mean's, ADR-190's declaration.
